snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Seventh Singularity: Babylonia PV
snippet.description:
"The “Seventh Singularity: Absolute Demonic Front – Babylonia” is fast approaching!  Gather your Servants for biggest battle leading up to the finale! The fate of humanity lies in your hands.

Prologue:
2655 B.C.E. The seventh Grand Order.  This is the age when humans and gods first parted ways.  The Three Goddess Alliance, formed to destroy humanity.   A prophecy of destruction threatening to consume Uruk.  Facing ultimate demise, your greatest battle begins!

Release date: 2018-12-06 23:00 PST

For more information, visit fate-go.us/chapter7"
